steps.title: Elena Park: founder due-diligence notes · part 1
steps.detail: Elena Park asks for a founder due-diligence notes. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Elena Park: founder due-diligence notes · part 2
steps.detail: The founder due-diligence notes now has conflicting notes. Elena Park wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Elena Park: founder due-diligence notes · part 3
steps.detail: Elena Park is ready to introduce a paying client for the founder due-diligence notes. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented founder due-diligence notes. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Elena Park.
